t: Refuge from what you have not even done yet
a: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَمِلْتُ وَشَرِّ مَا لَمْ أَعْمَلْ
p: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ʿamiltu wa min sharri mā lam aʿmal.
m: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done, and from the evil of what I have not done.
